name: instanode — CI health
description: CI / test / deploy health from the InstantCITestRun + InstantCITestFailure custom events emitted by the .github/actions/nr-ci-event composite action across the api / worker / instanode-web repos (Wave 5, docs/ci/01-CI-INTEGRATION-DESIGN.md §NR observability). Every gated job (build-and-test, coverage, integration, playwright, pr-smoke, e2e-prod, deploy) POSTs an InstantCITestRun{repo,workflow,branch,commit_sha,pr_number,result,duration_ms,suite} on completion (if:always) and an InstantCITestFailure{...,failed_step,log_url} on a red run, so a failure is studyable HERE, not just in the GitHub Actions log. The emit no-ops cleanly when NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY / NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID is unset (fork PRs), so absence of data for a repo means the secret is unprovisioned, not that CI is green. Pairs with the ci-* alerts under newrelic/alerts/.

pages.name: CI health
pages.description: Pass rate, suite duration, flake rate, and failure breakdown across all repos

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'pass') AS 'pass %' FROM InstantCITestRun FACET repo SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'pass') AS 'pass %' FROM InstantCITestRun SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'failures' FROM InstantCITestRun WHERE result = 'fail' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'pass') AS 'pass %' FROM InstantCITestRun FACET repo TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT percentile(duration_ms, 50) AS 'p50 ms', percentile(duration_ms, 95) AS 'p95 ms' FROM InstantCITestRun WHERE duration_ms > 0 FACET suite TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM InstantCITestRun WHERE result = 'fail' FACET workflow SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM InstantCITestRun WHERE result = 'fail' FACET suite SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Flake signal — commits with a fail AND a pass on the same suite (7d)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE result = 'pass') AS 'pass runs', filter(count(*), WHERE result = 'fail') AS 'fail runs' FROM InstantCITestRun FACET repo, suite, commit_sha LIMIT 50 SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Live-prod e2e + pr-smoke results (TIMESERIES) — user-facing journeys

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE result = 'pass') AS 'pass', filter(count(*), WHERE result = 'fail') AS 'fail' FROM InstantCITestRun WHERE suite IN ('e2e-prod', 'pr-smoke') FACET suite TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 3 days ago

widgets.title: Recent CI failures (failed_step + log_url for triage)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT repo, workflow, suite, branch, commit_sha, pr_number, failed_step, log_url FROM InstantCITestFailure SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 100
SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE result = 'pass') AS 'pass', filter(count(*), WHERE result = 'fail') AS 'fail' FROM InstantCITestRun WHERE suite = 'deploy' FACET repo TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: CI run volume by repo (7d) — confirms emit is wired (no data = secret unprovisioned)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM InstantCITestRun FACET repo SINCE 7 days ago
